explanation: For rand_pcg 0.10.2, state returns the exact stored word for Lcg64Xsh32, Lcg128Xsl64, Lcg128CmDxsm64 and Mcg128Xsl64. For the three LCG types, stream returns the stored increment shifted logically right by one; from_state preserves the given state and stores increment=(stream<<1) OR 1, discarding the highest stream bit. Their new constructors normalize that increment and initialize state=((input_state+increment)*multiplier+increment), with state-width modular arithmetic. The multipliers are 6364136223846793005, 47026247687942121848144207491837523525, and 15750249268501108917, respectively. Mcg128Xsl64::new stores input_state OR 1. Each of these fourteen original APIs terminates normally in the model for arbitrary scalar inputs. The prior Lcg64Xsh32::try_next_u32 exact PCG-XSH-RR output/state theorem is also retained, for fifteen initial proved API bodies. Their 32-bit methods return the low 32 bits of the corresponding 64-bit result with exactly the same state update.
